gloss: end of an act; finale; conclusion

definitions.gloss: end of an act; final scene; curtain fall
definitions.explanation: The closing scene or final moments of an act in a play or theatrical performance.
The concluding phase or final moments of an event, situation, or era. Used figuratively.

examples.japanese: {幕切|まくぎ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧だった。
⟦{芝居|しばい}→芝居：03195_shibai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幕切|まくぎ}れ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}した→流す：01968_nagasu⟧。
examples.english: The audience shed tears at the final scene of the play.

notes:
FORMATION: ⟦{幕|まく}→幕：12518_maku⟧ (curtain, act) + {切|き}れ (cutting, end). Originally a theater term referring to the moment when the curtain falls at the end of an act.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幕切|まくぎ}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach the finale
- ⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{幕切|まくぎ}れ: a splendid ending
- ⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧な{幕切|まくぎ}れ: an unexpected ending
- {幕切|まくぎ}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧: the closing scene

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {幕切|まくぎ}れ: ending, finale (theatrical origin, literary)
- ⟦{結末|けつまつ}→結末：15091_ketsumatsu⟧: conclusion, outcome (neutral, for stories/events)
- フィナーレ: finale (loanword, often for performances)
